#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

const int MOD = 1000000007;

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    int n;
    cin >> n;

    // Try to read from input.txt, fallback to stdin
    ifstream fin("input.txt");
    if (fin.is_open()) {
        fin >> n;
        fin.close();
    }

    int total = 2 * n;

    vector<int> cur(n + 1, 0);
    cur[1] = 1;
    int ans = 0;

    for (int j = 1; j <= n; j += 2) {
        ans = (ans + cur[j]) % MOD;
    }

    for (int step = 1; step < total; step++) {
        vector<int> next(n + 1, 0);
        for (int j = 0; j <= n; j++) {
            int v = cur[j];
            if (j + 1 <= n) {
                next[j + 1] = (next[j + 1] + v) % MOD;
            }
            if (j - 1 >= 0) {
                next[j - 1] = (next[j - 1] + v) % MOD;
            }
        }
        cur = next;

        if ((step & 1) == 0) {
            int limit = total - 1 - step;
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j += 2) {
                if (j <= limit) {
                    ans = (ans + cur[j]) % MOD;
                }
            }
        }
    }

    // Try to write to output.txt, fallback to stdout
    ofstream fout("output.txt");
    if (fout.is_open()) {
        fout << ans << "\n";
        fout.close();
    } else {
        cout << ans << "\n";
    }

    return 0;
}
